aboutPage.valuesIntro: These simple promises shape a stay at S T Amar Bari.

values.title: Home
values.body: Amar Bari means “My Home” in Bangla. Guests are welcomed as they would be in a family house by the sea.

values.title: Hospitality
values.body: A warm welcome, quiet garden-view rooms, and time to enjoy Saint Martin at an island pace.

values.title: Honesty
values.body: Garden view, attached bathroom and hot water. Air conditioning, Wi-Fi and television are not currently available.

values.title: Care
values.body: Treat the garden, the beach and the island with care. Carry waste back where you can, and leave the shore as you found it.

aboutPage.mission: To give guests a peaceful Saint Martin stay that feels like home — simple, warm, and honest about island life.
aboutPage.welcomeIntro: A published staff directory is not available yet. Until names and photographs are shared by the family, this is how we host.

home.experiencesIntro: Saint Martin is small enough to walk and slow enough to notice. These are the days guests remember.

experiences.title: Turquoise mornings
experiences.body: Clear water and an empty shore before the first boats arrive.

experiences.title: Chhera Dwip
experiences.body: The island's southern tip, reached at low tide or by a short boat ride.

experiences.title: Coral shores
experiences.body: Rock pools and coral stones along Bangladesh's only coral coast.

experiences.title: Fresh from the sea
experiences.body: The day's catch, grilled simply at the island's beachside stalls.

experiences.title: Coconut groves
experiences.body: Shaded paths between palms and village gardens, at an island pace.

experiences.title: Island evenings
experiences.body: Quiet nights, a sky full of stars and the sound of the tide.

home.roomsEmpty: Room details are being published. Call or WhatsApp the resort for availability.
home.islandBody: Nine kilometres off the Teknaf coast, Saint Martin is a small island of coconut palms, coral shores and fishing villages. Ships run in season, and schedules change, so always confirm before you travel.
home.islandBody2: We share honest notes on getting here, the tides, the weather and what to pack.
home.whyIntro: When you book here, you speak with the resort itself — no middlemen, no surprises.
